items.title: Massive sea lion makes rare appearance in San Francisco

items.summary: The estimated 2,000-pound Steller sea lion nicknamed 'Chonkers' is hanging out at San Francisco's Pier 39 and drawing fans from across the country. The massive mammal made waves about a month ago when he hauled himself onto the pier and decided to stay. While California sea lions typically crowd the area, ‘Chonkers’ quickly stood out for his massive size. He is one of at least two Steller sea lions recently spotted in the bay. The animal is more commonly found in the colder waters of Alaska and the Pacific Northwest, making sightings in the Bay Area less common.
items.summary_zh: 估计2000磅的史泰勒海狮昵称"Chonkers" 挂在旧金山的39号码头,并吸引全国各地的粉丝. 巨型哺乳动物大约一个月前在码头上 制造了大浪,然后决定留下来 加州海狮通常挤满了当地, 他是湾里最近发现的至少两只斯特勒海狮之一. 该动物更常见于阿拉斯加和西北太平洋较冷的水域中,使得湾区的目击活动较少见.

items.title: The sub-Arctic town pitching itself as Canada's gateway to Europe
items.title_zh: 亚北极的小镇 把自己当作加拿大通往欧洲的门户
items.summary: The Port of Churchill sits idle for most of the year, blanketed by snow and frozen by the bitter cold climate of Canada's sub-Arctic. It's only operational in the summer for four months, sometimes five.
items.summary_zh: 丘吉尔港闲置了一年的大部分时间,被雪覆盖,被加拿大亚北极的苦寒气候冰冻. 它只在夏季运行4个月,有时5个月.

items.title: A son overlooked and a jailed tycoon: Inside Samsung's succession drama
items.title_zh: 一个儿子被忽略和一个被囚禁的大亨:三星继承剧情内部
items.summary: When power shifts at the top of some of the world's biggest companies, most people don't notice.
items.summary_zh: 当电力在世界上一些最大公司的顶端转移时,大多数人不会注意到.
